scenario.user_report: Only one Pokemon attacked at a time, changing after a KO. Initial no-shields recollection was subsequently uncertain.
scenario.verified_shields: Obstagoon used both shields against Camerupt Earth Power; Pixel badge crops show 2 to 1 to 0 and Moondrop retained frame shows the shield.

confirmed_findings: Greninja and Lucario have zero Fast Move uses in either archive.
Both perspectives contain six Obstagoon uses, including one initially unattributed use on Moondrop.
No Camerupt assignment to the wrong team was found in this pair.
Pixel records the Earth Power defense debuff with the named announcement and matching audio cue.

corrections.issue: Two duplicate opponent Incinerates in Moondrop
corrections.change: Allow repeated measured border-pulse identity to supply the move duration for pulse/damage fusion; speculative higher-energy ties do not qualify.
corrections.regression: The selected Camerupt segment has five distinct HP losses and now produces five fused uses, keeping all independent raw articles intact.

corrections.issue: Incinerate changed to Ember after a charge move
corrections.change: Remember the evidence families supporting identity across QTE cadence resets; camera motion alone cannot replace a repeated-impact identity. Fresh repeated impact evidence can still correct it.

corrections.issue: Abomasnow QTE artwork matched GO on Pixel at 37.712 seconds
corrections.change: Reject overlapping white components that do not form adjacent GO glyphs; stop countdown capture after actual combat evidence without inventing a witnessed GO.

corrections.issue: Live HUD could no longer be repositioned
corrections.change: Long press anywhere on the visible battle panel, then drag. Screen-coordinate deltas follow the finger while the window moves. Release saves the existing device-specific HUD layout, without edge snapping or new labels/icons.

corrections.issue: Nighttime decision timer was visible but no accepted timer articles were present in either archive
corrections.change: Accept the dark navy dial interior and rim while retaining white-arc geometry and repeated legal numeral confirmation. The original saved 9 and 11 are read by OCR on the Moondrop. Empty nighttime crops remain rejected.

corrections.issue: Replacement pause lacked a visible replay dial, especially on the opponent side
corrections.change: Show a central remaining-time arc and actual seconds when witnessed; for a bounded named-faint-to-replacement interval, show a waiting dial without invented numerals. Retain reconstruction basis and source article IDs; suppress fast moves during either side’s supported pause.

corrections.issue: Obstagoon could be replaced before its KO animation
corrections.change: Associate a late named faint only with the immediately outgoing same-side actor within two seconds, preserving original source time. Fit its complete fall and subsequent colour drain before the recorded replacement, with a brief lying-down beat. Fit incoming charged-projectile timing before that pose. No archive articles are changed.

remaining_limits: Opening source gaps are 3.834 seconds on Pixel and 6.325 seconds on Moondrop. Standalone HP measurement is substantially faster, so the live startup bottleneck remains unlocalized.
Counts from the two archives still differ. No missing impacts were fabricated to force agreement.
Existing archives retain their original evidence and derived articles; corrected live inference requires a new match for acceptance.
User HP search regions are retained. Local tracking and wide reacquisition must handle moving bars; shrinking the saved crops is not the remedy.
Actual numbered decision-timer testimony is absent from this recorded pair. Replay uses an explicitly reconstructed waiting dial; the corrected live reader must be checked in a new match.
